args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Tamarack Components newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026," its linked article (https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse), and the IRONWOOD companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion?project=IRONWOOD):

- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 warehouse automation deployments using autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned, so timelines should be budgeted conservatively.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (per the IRONWOOD companion case study).
